content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VNSGU Recruitment
content_sections.text: Visit the official online recruitment portal at https://vnsgunt.samarth.edu.in. Review the eligibility criteria and ensure you possess the prescribed qualifications before applying. Register and fill out the online application form with accurate details without modifying any mandatory content. Upload all necessary documents along with the online application. Pay the required application fee. (If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications and additional fees for each). Submit the application online on or before 11 November 2026 till 6:00 PM. Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference. (Applicants already in service must apply through their proper channel or send an advance copy with an application fee and mark "ADVANCE COPY" on the envelope, producing a "No Objection Certificate" at the interview).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates and marksheets Certificate of basic computer application knowledge (for Junior Clerk/Typist) Disability certificate from the competent authority of the state Caste/Category certificate (SC/ST/SEBC/EWS) from the competent authority of the state, if applicable Current Financial Year’s Non-Creamy Layer Certificate in the prescribed proforma (for SEBC candidates) No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer (for candidates already in service)

content_sections.heading: VNSGU Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit applications exclusively through the online recruitment portal on or before 11 November 2026 till 6:00 PM. Reservation benefits are restricted to SC, ST, SEBC, and EWS candidates of the origin of Gujarat. Applicants desiring to apply for more than one post must submit separate applications and application fees. Direct applications from candidates already in service will not be considered unless sent as an advance copy through proper channels. No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates attending Written Examinations or Verification of Documents. Admit cards, hall tickets, and call letters will be sent to candidates by e-mail only. Any change in address must be communicated in writing to the Registrar, Veer Narmad South Gujarat University.

faq.question: Q1. What is VNSGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: VNSGU Recruitment 2026 is a special recruitment drive for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) to fill 3 administrative positions including Technical Assistant, Computer Operator, and Junior Clerk/Typist on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under VNSGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been notified for administrative positions under this special recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for VNSGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 11 November 2026 till 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for VNSGU Junior Clerk/Typist?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree from a UGC-recognized university and a certificate of basic computer application knowledge from a recognized institute.
